Cost is 2 GENERIC in this model, which OVERSTATES slightly: the real cost is {1}{W} and the model does not check the white pip.

limits: This file publishes profiles, bands and placements; a composite score is refused at the ◆ tier (benchmark.score is None; calibrate.MIN_DECKS is 10). The rating is ★ coaching, per deck, in rating.json.
Benchmark figures are an unopposed ceiling under one frozen harness (no pod, no blockers, no removal); goldfish kill is one column, never the rule.
Per-turn curves come from the benchmark's own run, never from a deck's goldfish_metrics.json: the deck's own file is measured under its own opt-in channels and two of them are not comparable.
DeckCheck's Threat Index is an LLM's read of the list that moves between scans; it is dated external evidence, shown beside the floor, and it never gates.

The Forge table record describes the AI's piloting of the list it played, not the deck's strength (the pilot's rule, 2026-10-18: not a power read until the harness work is done); `stale` marks a run on an older list.
The survey is the pilot's own 1-5 scores, authored at log time; it is never a band member and a mean is shown only with its n, min and max.
A bracket group needs 3 members for a band; below that the band is absent and the placement says so.
The fleet is the SLEEVED decks: a bracket group bands and ranks sleeved Commander decks only; a brewing or bench deck keeps its row (`member: false`) and joins no group.
B2 has 1 member(s): no bands, placements read 'no band'.
B4 has 2 member(s): no bands, placements read 'no band'.
